newsitem.title: UK: WH Smith shares up after half year results.
newsitem.headline: WH Smith shares up after half year results.

text.p: Shares in WH Smith Group Plc were indicated higher on Wednesday after the company doubled its first half profits, beating most analysts expectations.
The shares were indicated 4-1/2p higher at 434-1/2p by 0806 GMT, in pre-market trade.
First half pretax profits of 38.6 million stg beat analysts forecasts of between 36-38.5 million stg, climbing from 17.3 million stg seen in the same period a year ago.
The interim dividend was maintained at 5.25p per share.
WH Smith said that like-for-like sales over the Christmas period were up only three percent.
